Name: Remember Facility Upgrades
Description:
[h2]Remember Facility Upgrades[/h2]

Ever watched a battle turn your carefully tuned facility into scrap, waited for Stardeus to rebuild it, and discovered that the replacement had forgotten every upgrade that made it useful? Or watched a colonist tear out a module during a mental breakdown and wander off with your carefully planned configuration? Well, have I got an aggressively organized recovery checklist for you!

Remember Facility Upgrades records the exact modules assigned to facility upgrade slots. When Stardeus automatically replaces a damage-destroyed facility, or Core's Stealing Upgrades breakdown tears out a module, the mod places ordinary Install Upgrade orders so the facility can reclaim its previous configuration.

[h2]Features[/h2]

[h3]Exact Upgrade Memory[/h3]
- Scans constructed facilities once after loading a game
- Tracks later upgrade installs, removals, relocations, and facility removals through game events
- Remembers the exact upgrade type assigned to every occupied slot
- Stores pending damage-rebuild assignments with the save

[h3]Automatic Rebuild Recovery[/h3]
- Captures installed modules before damage destruction ejects them
- Matches Stardeus's automatic replacement by facility definition, layer, and position
- Keeps the remembered assignment while the replacement is missing or under construction
- Restores through Stardeus's ordinary Install Upgrade jobs after construction finishes

[h3]Stealing Upgrades Recovery[/h3]
- Lets Core's mental breakdown and theft happen normally
- Identifies the exact module and slot Core emptied
- Queues an ordinary Install Upgrade job for the stolen module
- Waits for the same physical module to return to inventory instead of creating a free replacement

[h3]Safety and Player Control[/h3]
- Never overwrites an occupied slot or a different upgrade already awaiting installation
- Leaves missing, incompatible, and out-of-range upgrades unresolved and records the problem in the game log
- Treats intentional player removal and deconstruction as final
- Does not change mental breakdowns, upgrade effects, compatibility, construction, hauling, worker selection, or installation rules

[h2]Important Behavior[/h2]

Damage recovery applies only to facilities removed through Stardeus's normal automatic rebuild process. Theft recovery applies only when Core's Stealing Upgrades breakdown removes the module. The breakdown still occurs, the colonist still carries the real module away, and the replacement job waits until that module is available under Core's ordinary rules.

A rebuilt facility must finish construction before its remembered Install Upgrade jobs can be created. All recovery jobs still need real modules, eligible workers, and reachable work, so they may wait for the same reasons as an upgrade ordered manually.

If you deliberately remove an upgrade or deconstruct a facility, the mod treats that decision as final. If you assign a different upgrade before recovery runs, that player choice is left untouched.

[h2]Requirements[/h2]

Requires [b]Stardeus 0.15.0[/b]. Remember Facility Upgrades has no additional mod dependencies.

[h2]In Short[/h2]

You built the facility. You tuned the slots. Stardeus rebuilds the shell or somebody steals a module. Remember Facility Upgrades brings back the plan.

[b]Destroyed or stolen. Recovered right. Upgraded like you left it.[/b]
